purpose: 500 independent discovery futures probes across Sep3 to learn failure modes after applying Sep1/Sep2 lessons. Includes a separate non-overlapping sequential subset for deployability sanity.

rules.profit_rule: Normal profit exits at 0.33% or 0.44% gross; 3x-fee floor activates only after a prior bar proves >=0.33% MFE
rules.toxic_volume_rule: avoid 1.0x-2.0x relative volume except none in this discovery engine

notes: 500 discovery observations may overlap in time; they are independent research probes, not 500 simultaneously executable BTC positions.
Sequential subset is non-overlapping and equity-compounded.
Historical full L2 unavailable; Binance 1m taker-buy delta remains an aggressor-flow proxy.
Sep3 parameters were set from Sep1/Sep2 lessons before reading Sep3 results.
